data.one_liner: Extends json_serializable to support immutable collections like BuiltList and KtList.
data.what_it_does: It adds support for additional immutable collection types, including BuiltList, BuiltSet, BuiltMap, KtList, KtSet, and KtMap, when using json_serializable for code generation.
use_when: You use json_serializable and need to serialize BuiltValue collections
You use json_serializable and need to serialize Kt collections
avoid_when: You do not use code generation or json_serializable
You only need standard Dart collections or standard json_serializable supported types
strengths: Enables seamless JSON serialization for immutable collections
Integrates directly with the json_serializable ecosystem
weaknesses: Requires specific build.yaml configuration to avoid builder conflicts
Unofficial package relying on json_serializable internals
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and configure build.yaml to prevent conflicts with the standard json_serializable builder.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides its own immutable value types and built-in serialization solution instead of relying on json_serializable.
